title: Gender Budget 2026-27 Rises to 9.37% of Union Budget
summary: Gender Budget allocation increases to ₹5.01 lakh crore (9.37% of Union Budget), spanning 53 Ministries and 5 UTs.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Gender Budget 2026-27 Rises to 9.37% of Union Budget. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Gender Budget allocation for FY2026-27 rose to **9.37% of the Union Budget** (up from 8.86% in FY26), totaling **₹5.01 lakh crore**.
**Top Ministry**: Ministry of Women & Child Development (81.73% share).
